name: sf-modbus-driver
info:
Modbus TCP 驱动 v10: MBAP+PDU构造 + 字节序(ABCD/BADC/CDAB/DCBA) + 模拟模式

输入: msg.payload = { id, deviceName, plcIp, plcPort, protocolParams, tags[], timeout, maxRetries, retryInterval }
输出: msg.payload = { deviceId, deviceName, success, data, error, driverType, plcIp, plcPort }

protocolParams:
  slaveId: 从站ID (默认1)
  functionCode: 功能码 (默认3=Read Holding Registers)
  byteOrder: ABCD | BADC | CDAB | DCBA (默认ABCD)
  dataType: INT16 | UINT16 | FLOAT32 (默认INT16)

v10 Phase 2 — 独立可测

name: Modbus TCP驱动
